data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella for 2027? One of the first things to check is the group size limit. Every boat has a strict maximum passenger capacity, set by safety regulations and insurance. Our fleet offers options for groups from 5 to 12 guests, all departing from Puerto Banús. In this guide, we break down the limits, pricing, and what's included so you can choose the right boat for your party.

Marbella Yacht Charter Group Size Limits 2027: Overview

The maximum group size for a Marbella yacht charter in 2027 ranges from 5 to 12 passengers, depending on the vessel. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are perfect for intimate groups. Mid-size options such as the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) suit families or small friend groups. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), and Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offer ample space. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA.

Group Size Limits by Boat Category

Our fleet is divided into tiers for easy comparison. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) accommodate 9–11 guests and cost from €749 for 2 hours to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B includes the Mangusta 80 (white and grey), which takes 12 guests and starts at €4,719 for 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. All other boats, such as the Canados 86 (12 pax), Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax), and Lagoon 380 (10 pax), have pricing on request via WhatsApp. Always confirm the exact capacity for your chosen boat.

Why Group Size Limits Matter for Your Charter

Exceeding the passenger limit is not allowed—it's a safety and insurance requirement. The skipper will enforce the limit, so book a boat that fits your group exactly. For example, if you have 10 guests, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) are ideal. For 12, choose the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, or K80. If your group is larger than 12, consider booking two boats. We can arrange a multi-boat charter from Puerto Banús to keep your party together.

Small Groups: Best Boats for 5–6 Guests

For groups of 5–6, smaller vessels offer a cosy and cost-effective experience. The Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are great for couples or small families. The Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) and Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) provide a bit more space. These boats are perfect for a quick afternoon cruise along the Marbella coastline, visiting spots like Cala del Faro or Cabopino. All include the same premium inclusions as larger yachts.

Medium Groups: Best Boats for 8–11 Guests

Groups of 8–11 have several excellent options. The Astondoa 40 (9 pax) and Azimut 39 (11 pax) are Tier A favourites, with transparent pricing. The Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) and Lagoon 380 (10 pax) offer a different feel—the Lagoon is a catamaran with extra deck space. For 11 guests, the Azimut 39 is your best bet. These boats are ideal for a day trip to Estepona or Sotogrande, with plenty of room for sunbathing and socialising.

Large Groups: Best Boats for 12 Guests

If your party is 12, you have the widest choice. The Mangusta 80 (both white and grey) are popular for their speed and style, plus a free jet ski. The Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, and Maiora 26m all accommodate 12 guests with luxurious amenities. These yachts are perfect for full-day charters, exploring the Costa del Sol from Puerto Banús to Cala Cortés. Pricing for these boats is available on request via WhatsApp, so get in touch for a custom quote.

What's Included in Every Marbella Yacht Charter

Regardless of group size, every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees—you just bring your group and enjoy. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed; for others, we provide a tailored quote. Remember, the skipper is there to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience, so relax and take in the views of La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile.
